# FacetDiverseResult { #dyf.FacetDiverseResult }

```python
FacetDiverseResult(indices, bucket_ids, similarities, buckets_covered)
```

Result of facet-based diversification.

Facet diversification selects one item per semantic bucket, providing
"different perspectives on the same topic" rather than "different things".

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name            | Type                                     | Description                             |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| indices         | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Selected item indices (one per facet)   |
| bucket_ids      | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Bucket ID for each selected item        |
| similarities    | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Query similarity for each selected item |
| buckets_covered | [int](`int`)                             | Number of unique buckets in result      |
